title: Formal Logic
description: Axioms, inference rules, proofs. Unlocks the Formal Proof Assistant and the Empty Set.

puzzle.goal: A truth function of n propositional variables is fixed by its truth table, which has 2ⁿ rows. Count all possible truth functions by grouping them according to how many rows are true: choose which k of the rows are true, and add over every possible k.
puzzle.name: Counting Boolean functions (binomial sum over truth tables)
puzzle.form: sum ( k , 0 , 2 ^ n , binom ( 2 ^ n , k ) )
puzzle.ask: The binomial sum collapses to 2^(2ⁿ). Find how many distinct truth functions exist on n = 3 variables.
puzzle.method: Each subset of the 2ⁿ rows is the set of rows where the function is true; count subsets of each size with a binomial coefficient.
